title: [Pre Order] Google Pixel 11 Pro XL 256GB $91.56/Month + 240GB/Month $50/Month Plan for 12 Months @ Optus
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Google Pixel 11 Pro XL 256GB $91.56/Month + 240GB/Month $50/Month Plan for 12 Months @ Optus

[huey] Looks like there is a $40 promo for the $60 plan so the the deal is $120 cheaper.
[zacaryf] ya if you only need 60gb then ya you are right. but i use more than that
[huey] Your trying to sell a deal to people here. The pitch is the lowest cost and you didn't even mention the download limits.
[keishton] Finder has a deal where you get $200 if get a phone + plan which you can stack with $40/month + $1000 off
[StevieRay] I'm pretty tempted by sub $1400 ( after finder credit) for the XL Pro $40/mth over 12mth deal to upgrade my Pixel 7 which I bought when the 8 came out but I still cannot bring myself to spend over $1k for a phone.
[BargainsGrabber] Plan becomes $30/month if you’re currently with Optus
[brich1980] I have an Optus prepaid but I add the phone and the cheapest $40 plan (down from $60), then the loyalty offer $30 (extra $10 off) is showing as 2nd plan i.e. I need to get the plan twice but I don't need two plans. Any clue?
[BargainsGrabber] Not really sure. I’m on the Optus plan that I signed up from Gerry, and I could add a new service for the $30/month
This is what the cart should look like
https://files.ozbargain.com.au/upload/399144/131117/img_6599…
[JandersC] Mine says there's a minimum total cost of $2,055.46 with the $40 a month 60gb plan, but 12 x $131.56 should only be $1578.72?
[Flintz] 12GB RAM only though vs 16GB on pixel 10 pro xl
[Jack D Price] That's about $1000 difference right there…..
